title: the Weeping Wood Rising Anew
premise: Dominic Winterbourne has spent her life in the Weeping Wood, a valley where magic cannot follow and her forbidden gift of speaking with beasts lies dormant. When a dying courier presses a map into her hands — a map to the Heartroot, the source of all wild magic — she becomes the unwilling bearer of a secret that the Crown's witch-hunters will burn whole villages to recover. Guided by a disgraced knight sworn to destroy what she is sworn to protect, Dominic must choose between duty, love, and survival as their uneasy alliance deepens into something neither can afford. In the end, Dominic reaches the Heartroot and discovers it is dying, not weaponizable: she must pour her own gift into it to reignite magic across the land, sacrificing her voice among beasts and her old life in the valley, while the knight chooses exile over his oath to shield her final act.
about_author: Xanthe Eriksen is the pen name of a former wildlife rehabilitator who spent a decade in remote forest stations before turning to fiction. She writes fantasy rooted in animal behavior, folk justice, and the quiet violence of survival.

chapters.title: The Valley That Forgets
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Introduces the Weeping Wood, where magic cannot follow, and Dominic's suppressed gift that only stirs at the valley's edge. She tends goats and hides her strangeness from neighbors who burned a 'witch' a generation ago. Emotional beat: suffocating safety, the ache of a self half-buried.

chapters.title: A Stranger at the Treeline
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. A bloodied courier collapses at the valley boundary, beyond which he cannot be carried. He presses a wax-sealed map into her hands and dies whispering 'the Heartroot wakes.' Emotional beat: dread and reluctant responsibility; the first crack in her safe world.

chapters.title: What the Goats Knew
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Crossing the boundary, her gift floods back — the animals speak, and they are terrified. She learns the map leads to the Heartroot and that hunters already follow the dead courier's trail. Emotional beat: wonder curdling into fear as hiding becomes impossible.

chapters.title: The Knight of Ashes
chapters.summary: Ser Aldric's POV. Introduce the witch-hunter knight hunting the map, ordered by the Crown to end magic forever. He finds the courier's body and realizes someone from the valley took it. Emotional beat: weary conviction cracking around old guilt over a pyre he once lit.

chapters.title: Taken on the Road
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Witch-hunters raid the valley seeking the map; Dominic flees with nothing but the goats' warning. Her neighbor is taken in her place. Emotional beat: survivor's guilt ignites her resolve — she leaves the valley for good.

chapters.title: Bargain at the Crossroads
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Aldric corners Dominic but hesitates when a beast speaks through her to reveal his commander's plan to use the Heartroot as a weapon, not destroy it. They strike an uneasy truce. Emotional beat: mutual suspicion laced with recognition of kindred disillusionment.

chapters.title: The Drowned Chapel
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Sheltering in a flooded ruin, Dominic reads the map's true script with Aldric's help and learns the Heartroot is alive and failing. First real conversation between them. Emotional beat: tentative trust; love beginning its quiet, inconvenient work.

chapters.title: Wolves at the Ford
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV. An ambush by rival bounty hunters; wolves Dominic has befriended turn the tide, exposing her gift publicly. Aldric defends her against his own allies. Emotional beat: point of no return — he is now a traitor too.

chapters.title: The Price of the Neighbor
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. She learns her neighbor died under interrogation. Grief hardens into fury; she wants justice the law will never give. Aldric argues restraint; they clash bitterly. Emotional beat: the theme of justice outside the law takes its sharpest form.

chapters.title: City of Bells
chapters.summary: Dual POV. The pair infiltrates the capital to steal the Crown's half of the map. They witness the witch-trials' machinery up close. Emotional beat: horror and intimacy — a stolen night amid danger where duty and desire openly war.

chapters.title: The Archive Beneath
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. In the royal archive, Dominic learns the truth: the valley wasn't sanctuary, it was a prison built to starve the Heartroot of its last speaker-line. Her family were wardens. Emotional beat: identity shattered and remade — she was never hiding from destiny, only raised inside it.

chapters.title: Betrayal in White
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV. Aldric's former commander offers him full pardon if he delivers Dominic. He refuses, but a fellow knight overhears. The pair must flee the city hunted by their own allies. Emotional beat: love chosen over duty, at the cost of everything he was.

chapters.title: The Long Dark of Thornfell
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Wounded and lost in a cursed forest, Dominic bargains with its beast-court for passage — paying a piece of her memory of home. Emotional beat: the price of survival made literal; grief for a past she can no longer fully recall.

chapters.title: What Aldric Buried
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV. Confession by firelight: the pyre he lit years ago was a beast-speaker girl, and he has hunted her kin ever since to atone. Dominic must decide whether love can survive what he was. Emotional beat: forgiveness as a choice, not a feeling.

chapters.title: The Hunt Closes
chapters.summary: Dual POV. The commander's forces corner them at the mountain pass; the beasts of Thornfell arrive to honor Dominic's bargain, and a desperate running battle ensues. Emotional beat: terror and fierce gratitude; the natural world choosing sides.

chapters.title: Ascent to the Heartroot
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. They climb to the hidden grove and find the Heartroot dying, choked by centuries of severance. The map was never a treasure — it was a plea for a new warden. Emotional beat: awe and terrible clarity about what is being asked of her.

chapters.title: The Commander's Judgment
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV. The commander arrives with an army intending to harvest the Heartroot's power. Aldric stands alone between them, formally renouncing his oath before the men he led. Emotional beat: defiant sacrifice; justice declared outside every law.

chapters.title: The Weeping Wood Rising
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Climax. To save the Heartroot, Dominic pours her gift into it, unleashing magic back across the land and shattering the valley's severance — but silencing her voice with beasts forever. The commander falls to the awakened wood itself. Emotional beat: triumph braided with irreversible loss.

chapters.title: After the Green Fire
chapters.summary: Aldric's POV. The army scatters; Aldric finds Dominic alive but hollowed, unable to hear the creatures mourning and celebrating around them. He chooses exile from the Crown to stay at her side. Emotional beat: tenderness after devastation; love without duty's shadow.

chapters.title: The Quiet Gift
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Returning to the transformed valley, Dominic discovers the Heartroot left one seed of her gift within her — she no longer commands beasts, but they trust her, and follow unbidden. Emotional beat: bittersweet acceptance; power exchanged for belonging.

chapters.title: Justice of the Living Law
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Survivors of the witch-trials gather as the wood itself begins judging old crimes; Dominic and Aldric choose mercy over vengeance for the rank-and-file hunters. Emotional beat: resolution of the justice theme — restoration over retribution.

chapters.title: Roots and Wings
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Epilogue. A year on, the Weeping Wood rises anew, magic threading through the world, and Dominic — no longer hiding, no longer alone — plants the Heartroot's first seedling with Aldric beside her. Emotional beat: peace earned, not given; a life rebuilt on chosen ground.
